The Contractor shall provide the required supervision, operators, materials, machinery and equipment to perform the maintenances and construction. The total amount of road kilometres to maintain is around 122 Km, considering the access road, internal roads at 2,900 meters above sea level, the road to get access to the Antennae Operations Site (AOS) and other internal roads at 5,000 meters above sea level. The contract will start during Q2/2021, for a period of 5 years (to be confirmed in CFT release) The Preliminary Inquiry is expected to be issued in Q2 2020 to potential suppliers in Chile, and will be followed by a Call for tender that is scheduled to be released in Q3 2020. The contract is expected to be awarded in Q1/2021, to the Bidder, which has submitted a fully compliant Tender and offers the best value for money for ESO taking into account the quality and price of the offer.
